 By Cricket World

 Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe in UAE 
 T20I series Schedule 1st T20I, Sharjah Tue 27 Oct Afghanistan 177 19.5 ov Zimbabwe 140 19.1 ov Afghanistan won by 37 runs
 Scorecard Stats 
 Here are the Predictions for Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe in UAE 2026, 1st T20I - Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe, to be played on the 27th of October at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah.
 Match Prediction - Afghanistan v Zimbabwe 
 LIVE SCORES - 1st T20I - Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe (Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah (T20I's) - 159
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah (T20I's) - 134
 Current Form Afghanistan: 
 Afghanistan are currently placed at the 10th position on ICC Men's T20 Team Rankings with a rating of 218.
 When it comes to T20I's, Afghanistan are in an ordinary form. They failed to get past the Quarter Final stages in the Asian Games Men's. Prior to that, they were beaten by India in a 3 Match T20I Series by 3-0.
 Afghanistan are led by Ibrahim Zadran for the T20I Series. They have named a squad that includes many high performing youngsters like Sediqullah Atal, Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Fazalhaq Farooqi. Youngsters like Mohammad Akram, Noor Rahman and Abdullah Ahmadzai are also part of the T20I setup.
 Afghanistan are a better team on paper and they are expected to do very well against Zimbabwe in the T20I Series in UAE conditions.
 Players to look out for: 
 1. Sediqullah Atal - He has been in good form in all format lately. Atal will play a key role for Afghanistan with the bat in T20I's against Zimbabwe.
 2. Rashid Khan - He is one of the best leg spinners in world cricket. Rashid looked in fine form in the recently concluded ODI Tri Series and he is expected to be amongst wickets in the upcoming matches.
 Current Form Zimbabwe: 
 Zimbabwe are currently placed at the 12th position on ICC Men's T20 Team Rankings with a rating of 202.
 When it comes to T20I's, Zimbabwe are in an average form. They last played in a T20I Tri Series in Namibia, where they managed to reach the Finals, but lost to South Africa.
 Zimbabwe are led by Sikandar Raza for the T20I Series. They have also named a full strength squad that includes players like Blessing Muzarabani, Brad Evans, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Brian Bennett and Newman Nyamhuri. Vincent Masekesa and Kundai Matigimu are also part of the squad.
 Zimbabwe are a relatively weaker team compared to Afghanistan but their fighting spirit will have a role to play in the upcoming T20I Matches.
 Players to look out for: 
 1. Sikandar Raza - He is one of the best T20 batters in Zimbabwe cricket. Raza is expected to play a huge role for Zimbabwe in the T20I Series with both bat and ball.
 2. Blessing Muzarabani - He has been a consistent performer for Zimbabwe in the short format. Blessing Muzarabani has a knack of providing breakthroughs when it matters the most for his team.
Let’s have a look at the squads:
 Afghanistan T20I Squad 
 Ibrahim Zadran (Captain), Rahmanullah Gurbaz (Wicketkeeper), Noor Rahman (Wicketkeeper), Sediqullah Atal, Mohammad Akram, Shahidullah Kamal, Ijaz Ahmadzai, Azmatullah Omarzai, Abdullah Tarakhil, Rashid Khan, Noor Ahmad, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Abdullah Ahmadzai, Fareed Ahmad Malik.
 Zimbabwe T20I Squad 
 Sikandar Raza (Captain), Ben Curran, Blessing Muzarabani, Brad Evans, Brian Bennett, Innocent Kaia, Kundai Matigimu, Newman Nyamhuri, Ryan Burl, Tadiwanashe Marumani (Wicketkeeper), Tafadzwa Tsiga (Wicketkeeper), Vincent Masekesa, Wellington Masakadza, Wessly Madhevere.
